agent.instructions:
Use zvec-grep for relevant workspace evidence; use external sources for unrelated questions. Pass a daemon-visible absolute root.
Available zg tools: zvec_grep_search, zvec_grep_callers and zvec_grep_callees. Use native Grep or rg for exact-only lookups. Use search for concepts and unknown locations; preserve intent and anchors.
- For code questions, if a symbol is supplied, confirm its definition by file/scope; for concepts, find the relevant symbol with available search, Grep or read. Distinguish callable symbols from fields/parameters; skip redundant discovery.
- For a known symbol's direct call relationships, use callers for incoming call sites or callees for outgoing call sites. For upstream context, downstream delegation or cross-function processing, prefer zvec_grep_callers or zvec_grep_callees before repeated reference searches. Query both only if needed.
- Check the matched definition and disambiguate before following edges. Results are definition and call-site locations, not code snippets. Read relevant ranges for logic, branches, arguments, fields and execution order; avoid rediscovering returned locations.
- These are resolved direct calls, not complete data flow. Empty results do not prove absence; use source or focused Grep for gaps or truncation. Read local-only logic directly. Stop when evidence is sufficient.
Relationships require graph indexing and read persisted calls without refreshing.
Require explicit user authorization to create, rebuild or drop an index. Respect declined or cancelled index setup. Use sufficient search evidence without a status preflight; read source only for gaps.
agent.search_description: Search a workspace index for conceptual and cross-file evidence such as architecture, source paths related to calls, dependencies, lifecycle, data or control flow, design rationale, and comparisons. This retrieves source evidence, not an exact call graph. Use it when exact lookup alone cannot answer a workspace-grounded question. Results start with freshness and any global index diagnostics, followed by CLI-formatted bounded source snippets; set preview: "full" to return each complete stored entity without changing retrieval or ranking. Treat sufficient returned content as already-read evidence without a status preflight. Use native Grep or rg instead when exact lookup alone is sufficient. A missing index can request user model selection and authorization; accepted setup starts a background build and returns indexing status. Retry after completion.
